title: Webhooks
description: Send FieldOps events to your own systems as signed HTTPS requests. Relay delivers them, retries failures for about a day and keeps a 7-day log.

notConfigured.title: Webhooks aren't set up on this server
notConfigured.body: An administrator needs to connect Relay (RELAY_URL and RELAY_API_KEY) before webhooks can be turned on.

unavailable.title: Relay can't be reached right now
unavailable.body: Endpoints and deliveries will show again once it answers. Events that happen in the meantime are queued and sent later.

toggle.label: Send events
toggle.on: On since {date}. Every change below is published as an event.
toggle.off: Off. Turn on to add endpoints; no events are recorded while it is off.
toggle.turnedOff: Webhooks are off. Endpoints stay, but get no new events.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Up to {max} URLs. Each one receives the events it subscribes to.
endpoints.addDisabled: Turn on webhooks to add an endpoint
endpoints.limit: This organization has the maximum of {max} endpoints.
endpoints.emptyHint: Add the URL of the system that should receive events, such as your CRM or an automation tool.

status.failingSince: {count, plural, one {# failed attempt} other {# failed attempts}} in a row since {date}
status.offByYou: Turned off by a person in your organization

form.urlHint: An https URL on a public host. FieldOps posts JSON to it.
form.allEvents: All events, including ones added later

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.body: Use this secret to verify that requests come from FieldOps. It is shown only now: copy it into your receiver's settings.
secret.rotatedBody: For the next 24 hours each request is signed with both the old and the new secret, so you can switch without dropping requests.
secret.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.

events.job.updated: A job's details changed (title, priority, customer, site, schedule…)
events.job.status_changed: A job moved to another status
events.sla.at_risk: A job used 75% of its response or resolution window
events.sla.breached: A job missed its response or resolution target
events.quote.sent: A quote was sent to the customer
events.invoice.paid: An invoice was paid in full
events.expense.decided: A part or expense request was approved or rejected
events.webhook.test: A test event sent from this page

catalog.title: Events
catalog.description: Every request carries the same envelope. Events are thin: they name the record and its key fields; fetch the rest from the API with an API key.

verify.title: Verifying requests
verify.description: Requests follow the Standard Webhooks format. Check the signature, reject timestamps more than 5 minutes off, answer 2xx within 10 seconds, and skip event IDs you've already processed: delivery is at least once.
verify.headers: Headers: webhook-id (the event ID), webhook-timestamp (Unix seconds) and webhook-signature (v1, a comma and the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of id.timestamp.body).

detail.rotateBody: You get a new secret. Requests are signed with both secrets for 24 hours, then only with the new one.
detail.deleteBody: It stops receiving events at once, and its delivery log is deleted. This can't be undone.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.emptyHint: Send a test event, or change a job, to see a delivery here.
